provenance.source: MOLA (Mars Orbiter Laser Altimeter) / Mars Global Surveyor (MGS)
provenance.product: Slope and traversability derived from MOLA elevation
provenance.notes: [DERIVED] Distributed by USGS Astrogeology Science Center. Archive: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) Cartography and Imaging Science Node. slope = degrees(arctan(|grad(elevation)|)) with 177.5 m NS / 187.1 m EW spacing traversability = banded cost multiplier per docs/nasa-data-catalog.md (0-5deg=1.0, 5-10=1.5, 10-15=2.5, 15-20=5.0, 20-25=10.0, >25=impassable) Slope inherits MOLA's 463 m/px resolution: real obstacles smaller than ~463 m are not represented.

provenance.source: THEMIS (Thermal Emission Imaging System) / 2001 Mars Odyssey
provenance.product: THEMIS Night Infrared controlled mosaic, global, v2 (Oct 2018)
provenance.notes: [DERIVED] Distributed by USGS Astrogeology Science Center. Archive: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) Cartography and Imaging Science Node. Windowed /vsicurl read of 592.7x533.5 px Bilinear resample to 300x300 Normalised to 0-1 across the 2nd-98th percentile of the window This is night-IR brightness normalised as a thermal inertia PROXY, not a published thermal inertia product. High values indicate heat-retaining (likely rocky) surfaces; low values indicate fast-cooling dust or loose sand.

provenance.product: Composite traverse hazard derived from MOLA slope and THEMIS night IR
provenance.notes: [DERIVED] Distributed by Derived by VICTOR. Archive: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) Cartography and Imaging Science Node. hazard = 10 * (0.7 * clip(slope/25, 0, 1) + 0.3 * (1 - thermal_proxy)) Hazard is a VICTOR weighting of measured inputs, not a NASA hazard product. The weights are a modelling choice.

provenance.source: CRISM (Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars) / Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO)
provenance.product: CRISM MRDR multispectral summary parameters, tile 20N078 (MC-13)
provenance.instrument: CRISM (Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars)
provenance.coordinate_system: Equirectangular, per-tile sphere; read via published 5x5 deg bounds
provenance.notes: [MEASURED] Distributed by NASA PDS Geosciences Node (Washington University in St. Louis). Archive: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) Geosciences Node. HTTP range read of 1.8 MB from the 576 MB ENVI BSQ cube (band 16 OLINDEX3, band 53 CINDEX2) Georeferenced via the product label's published 5x5 degree bounds Bilinear resample to 300x300 CRISM multispectral mapping has swath gaps: only 66% of the window is measured. Unmeasured cells are stored as -9999 and must be treated as NO DATA, never as 'no mineral'. Summary parameters are spectral indices, not mineral abundances.

provenance.source: CRISM summary parameters + Perseverance science targeting / MRO (CRISM) + Mars 2020 / published Jezero literature
provenance.product: Science priority from CRISM mineralogy and published Jezero targets
provenance.instrument: CRISM summary parameters + Perseverance science targeting
provenance.notes: [DERIVED] Distributed by Derived by VICTOR. Archive: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) Geosciences Node. 10 published science targets with literature coordinates mineral = normalised max(OLINDEX3, CINDEX2) from real CRISM spectra science = 0.6*mineral + 0.4*target_model where CRISM measured; target_model alone inside CRISM swath gaps A priority SCORE, not a measurement. The mineral indices underneath it are real CRISM measurements; collapsing them into one priority number is a VICTOR modelling choice. 66% of cells are CRISM-measured (DERIVED); the rest fall back to the target proximity model (MODELLED). Per-cell provenance therefore varies across the grid. Target sources: Ehlmann et al. 2008; Farley et al. 2022 (Science 377); Goudge et al. 2015; Goudge et al. 2017; Goudge et al. 2017; Farley et al. 2020; Mangold et al. 2021

provenance.notes: [DERIVED] Distributed by Derived by VICTOR. base = 0.75 (elevation source 463 m/px vs 177.5 m grid cell) x0.6 where CRISM provides no mineral measurement A 0-1 data COMPLETENESS index, not a probability and not an error bar.
